notes.title: Build Demo 1.1.1
notes.notes: [p]Build 1.1.1 — Demo Available.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 🏰 Dungeons[/p][p]- Dungeons now dynamically adjust the number of rooms depending on the number of players: more players = larger dungeon.  [/p][p]  Solo players will find it easier, while bigger teams will have plenty of space.  [/p][p]- The timer for entering/exiting the dungeon has been reduced from **10** to **5 seconds**.  [/p][p]- The number of webs on dungeon doors has been decreased.  [/p][p]- Stamina consumption when sprinting now only applies inside the dungeon. Feel free to run outside![/p][p]---[/p][p]## 🧩 Puzzle Rooms[/p][p]- Dark Vision now highlights platforms in the lava puzzle room.  [/p][p]- The password puzzle room has been updated.  [/p][p]- Dark Vision now shows the correct symbols in the password puzzle room.  [/p][p]- Music in the *Red Light, Green Light* puzzle room has been replaced.  [/p][p]- The time allowed to stop moving when the music stops has been increased.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 🛠 Bug Fixes[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where staring at the scarecrow for too long caused camera stutter instead of blocking the view.  [/p][p]- Fixed a bug where the clown wouldn’t switch to other players after killing someone.  [/p][p]- Fixed a bug where a chest could spawn inside a wall.  [/p][p]- Fixed a bug where opening a chest with a key removed an item from the host’s hands instead of consuming the key.  [/p][p]- Fixed a bug where the **Embertrail** spell sometimes failed to unlock when starting a dungeon run.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## ✨ New Features & Improvements[/p][p]- Added a tutorial explaining how to use the **Embertrail** spell and how to find the exit for new players.  [/p][p]- Added pointers that indicate points of interest on the map.  [/p][p]- Added the ability to purchase spells directly without performing the ritual.  [/p][p]- Performing the ritual to unlock a new spell **no longer requires mana**.  [/p][p]- Added an **Info** button next to the purchase button to view detailed item descriptions.  [/p][p]- Added missing item descriptions.  [/p][p]- Added an upgrade in the Upgrade Shop that allows you to wear the flashlight on your head, freeing your hands.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 💰 Balance & Economy[/p][p]- Prices for purchasing new rooms in the shop have been adjusted.  [/p][p]- Mana costs for using magic have been rebalanced.  [/p][p]- Prices for upgrades in the Upgrade Shop have been updated.  [/p][p]- Item and furniture prices in the shop have been adjusted.  [/p][p]- Added icons for specific product cost upgrades in the Upgrade Shop.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 📦 Your Chest[/p][p]- The starting capacity of your chest has been increased.  [/p][p]- The starting speed of your chest has been increased.[/p]
